message:
policy/v2: check SSHPolicy nil vs empty against captures

Nil keeps client's old rules; empty clears them. Old normalization hid it.

Updates #3508

policy/v2: test SSH rule removal yields empty SSHPolicy

Updates #3508

servertest: test client drops SSH rules on policy removal

Updates #3508

policy/v2: send an empty SSH policy when no rule applies

Nil SSHPolicy means "unchanged" to clients; removed rules stayed live.
Match SaaS: "rules":[].

Fixes #3508

mapper: send an empty SSH policy when compiling it fails

Fail closed; nil kept the client's previous rules.

Updates #3508

policy/v2: find SSH check params for localpart self-access

compileSSHPolicy sends these check rules; SSHCheckParams missed them,
so they never auto-approved within checkPeriod.

Updates #3508

noise: reject SSH checks the policy no longer requires

A stale check rule still held and accepted after login. Deny with a 200
Reject (tailssh retries errors); re-check after the verdict.

Updates #3508

policy/v2: match the login user in SSHCheckParams

The client picks the check rule by login user; the server took the
first rule for the node pair, so a root login could get a 12h
localpart period instead of "always", or be approved after its rule
was removed while another user's rule remained. Hold URLs now carry
the concrete user: tailssh never expanded the encoded $LOCAL_USER.

Updates #3508

integration: test SSH is denied once its rules are removed

Updates #3508

ci: regenerate integration test list

Updates #3508

noise: drop unused ErrNoAuthSession

Kept separate so the check-rule fix cherry-picks to 0.29.

Updates #3508

mapper: send SSHPolicy only when it changes for the connection

Any non-nil SSHPolicy forces a full client netmap rebuild; the empty
policy now sent to every node made each policy change one.

Updates #3508

CHANGELOG: note SSH rule removal fix
